svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Two sills: RHS 100 x 50 x 3, 1,150 mm; centres 600 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six crossbars SHS 50 x 50 x 3, 550 mm, tops flush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 1,125 mm. The 220 and 480 mm bars carry the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: blower plate; the 680 and 920 mm bars the engine plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Joint plates as the span module, at the joint end: 10 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 150 x 170 mm, four 18 mm holes drilled with the span

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: module's plates clamped to them, so the holes line up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Far end: a 3 mm cap over each sill end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld on a flat table, diagonals equal within 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: bolt it to the span module dry; the sill tops

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: line up within 2 mm across the joint.
